rows.description: A historic fort in Old Delhi that served as the main residence of the Mughal Emperors. Symbol of India's independence.

rows.name: Qutub Minar
rows.description: A 73-metre tall minaret and UNESCO World Heritage Site. Built in the early 13th century.

rows.name: Humayun's Tomb
rows.description: The tomb of the Mughal Emperor Humayun. First garden-tomb on the Indian subcontinent and inspired the Taj Mahal.
